verses.1: Armon and Arafat and Doqa, and those who worship idols in Zabulon and Edom, shall be put to shame, for the Lord has rejected them because of their wickedness and because of the works of their hands. Tyre and Sidon shall weep, for the time has drawn near when they shall be punished for their wickedness and for the idols which they made in their youth, and they did not forsake them until their old age.
verses.2: And because of this the Lord will punish them for what they did: fornication and defilement and adultery and idolatry. And the daughters of Judah have done evil, for they did not stand by the commandment of the Lord their Creator.
verses.3: Likewise, at the resurrection of the dead, evil shall be uncovered for Jerusalem, for she did not walk in the law and in the ordinances of the Lord, but walked in oppression and in the killing of the righteous.
verses.4: Truly the Lord is provoked to anger by the counsel of her wisdom, and He will punish her for all the evil she did in the days of her youth; and she did not forsake it in the days of her maturity, until her old age.
verses.5: And she entered into the tombs and became dust, like her former fathers who walked in their own counsel and transgressed the commandment of the Lord; as at the resurrection He will punish them.
verses.6: For Moses said concerning them: As the vine of Sodom is their vine.
verses.7: And their grapes are of Gomorrah, and their clusters are clusters of bitterness, and their grapes are bitter.
verses.8: Their wine is the venom of serpents and the cruel poison of asps that kill.
